name: Aloft South Jakarta
short_description: A modern select-service high-rise on the TB Simatupang corridor in South Jakarta, with the Fraya all-day restaurant, WXYZ bar, a rooftop Splash pool, Southside rooftop bar and a top-floor gym with city views.
ai_summary: Aloft South Jakarta is Aloft's lifestyle select-service tower on the TB Simatupang business corridor in Cilandak, South Jakarta, and was formerly listed as Aloft Jakarta TB Simatupang (the same hotel, renamed by Marriott). It is one of three Jakarta Alofts and should not be confused with Aloft Jakarta Wahid Hasyim in Central Jakarta or the Aloft near Kebon Jeruk in the west. The roughly 18-storey, ~170-room high-rise sits near CIBIS Park, Cilandak Town Square and Ragunan Zoo, convenient for the southern business parks and toll-road access but a 15-minute-plus drive from major malls. TripAdvisor rates it about 4 of 5 (roughly 75 reviews, ranked mid-pack among Jakarta hotels); Booking.com guests score staff around 9.0 and location and comfort near 8.9. Independent reviewers and creators consistently praise clean, spacious modern rooms with fast reliable WiFi, a scenic rooftop pool and bar, a top-floor gym with skyline views, warm attentive staff, and a diverse well-managed breakfast at Fraya. Common gripes are a smallish pool, a bar that closes early on weekdays, limited restaurant menu variety, and the distance to shopping. One outlier guest reported poor service, but the weight of feedback is positive. Net: strong-value, business-friendly base in South Jakarta, best for short lifestyle or corporate stays rather than resort-style leisure.

faqs.question: Is Aloft South Jakarta the same hotel as Aloft Jakarta TB Simatupang?
faqs.answer: Yes. Marriott renamed the property to Aloft South Jakarta; it is the same hotel on Jalan TB Simatupang in Cilandak, South Jakarta, formerly listed as Aloft Jakarta TB Simatupang.

faqs.question: How far is Aloft South Jakarta from Soekarno-Hatta Airport (CGK)?
faqs.answer: It is roughly 35 km from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, generally a 45-70 minute drive depending on Jakarta traffic.

faqs.question: What dining and facilities are available?
faqs.answer: The hotel has the Fraya all-day restaurant, the WXYZ bar, a rooftop Splash pool with the Southside rooftop bar and lounge, a top-floor fitness center with city views, and the Camp Aloft kids' area. Reviewers rate breakfast and the rooftop highly.

reviews.title: Ulasan Aloft South Jakarta: Pengalaman Staycation di Lantai 16 Jakarta Selatan
reviews.author: shofifadhil
reviews.summary: 16th-floor overnight praising city views, contemporary interiors with a bathtub, and fast WiFi seen as an edge over rivals. Breakfast rated diverse for a 4-star, spanning Indonesian dishes, fresh bread and live cooking stations.
